events.caption: The man and woman sit silently on opposite ends of the couch, facing away from each other after an apparent argument.
The man glances back at the woman and then quickly turns away again. He runs his hand over his head in frustration while the woman gestures dismissively from the other end of the couch.
The man fidgets with a pillow, glances at the woman, and throws the pillow at her back, but she continues to ignore him, propping her head up with her left arm.
The woman angrily snatches the pillow, hits the man with it, and then throws it on the floor, then turns back and props her head up with her left arm.
The man picks up the pillow from the floor, places it on his lap, glances briefly at the woman and quickly looks back toward the left side of the frame, and then rests his head in his hand.
The man picks up a receipt and hands it to the woman as they sit on the bed and discuss it.
The woman holds the small receipt and speaks earnestly to the downcast man as they sit together on the bed, then finally places it on the bed.
The man touches the receipt and then picks up his phone to calculate under the woman’s guidance.
The man puts down his phone, the woman unfolds a paper receipt and points to it while discussing it with the man sitting on the bed.
The man picks up his phone again, and the woman points at the screen as they sit on the bed and discuss their finances.
